summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing of Indonesian Payroll app. 14/14 pytest backend tests passing. End-to-end frontend flow (login, dashboard, employees CRUD, payroll preview/generate, payslip view, settings) all working.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS misconfiguration (potential future issue): server.py uses allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True. Per CORS spec, browsers reject this combination; cookies will not be sent cross-origin. Currently it works because frontend & backend share the same hostname (proxy), but if deployed on different origins it will break auth. Should be set to explicit origins from CORS_ORIGINS env.
All payroll math (PPh 21 brackets UU HPP, BPJS Kesehatan/JHT/JP, biaya jabatan, PTKP table) is implemented correctly and matches test assertions.
Idempotency on POST /api/payroll/run correctly handled by deleting prior run + slips before insert; unique index on payroll_runs.period also enforced.
Backend correctly excludes MongoDB _id from all responses (find with projection {_id:0}).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST001 employee and 2025-12 payroll period; both cleaned up via fixture finalizer. Frontend test created an FE##### employee (left in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_payroll_api.py covers auth, employee CRUD (incl. duplicate NIK), payroll preview math (BPJS 1%/2%/1%, PPh21, tax_detail keys), payroll run idempotency, dashboard stats, config constants. Frontend e2e covers login -> dashboard -> employees create -> payroll preview/generate -> payslip detail -> settings. All flows green.
